skill_friction: Jest tests live inside the LWC bundle folder and are excluded from deploy by .forceignore; spec-format says to list every deployable component and the testing guidance covers Apex and Flow Tests only, so it is unclear whether LWC Jest tests should be a separate Section 9 row. I folded them into the LightningComponentBundle row.

Record page activation cannot be read, but the whole UI responsibility depends on Case_Record_Page being the active page; the skill does not say whether this is a Conditional row, a blocking open item, or a manual check. I used a load-bearing assumption with a blocking-for-delivery manual check and did not mark the FlexiPage row Conditional.

Rule 3's two-wrong-claims threshold: AskCoworker's R answer made an imprecise platform claim (LDS auto-refresh) and R/T flagged Name FLS as blocking; it is unclear whether an Unknown that a query resolves (D1 child relationship) counts as a wrong claim. I counted one wrong platform claim, so the threshold was not reached.

The org-verification note says users with View All Data still see fields without FLS grants, which conflicts with documented behavior (FLS applies to admins too; admins normally have profile FLS). I avoided relying on it by checking the admin user's permission set assignments.
